title: i remaking 3d n-gage snakes game with ai
author: romramstudio
selftext:
it's called Neon Snake 3D, you can play it on android by downloadin in google playstore: [https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.romram.neonsnake3d&hl=en](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.romram.neonsnake3d&hl=en)

im using google ai studio and gemini 3.0 to generate the code and use capacitor to convert to android studio project and then build the apps in android studio.

comments.author: nuker0S
comments.body: NGL many games here don't seem to be much, but i think you nailed it

replies.author: romramstudio
replies.body: thanks, will have some updates and maybe add enemies to make the game more fun.

comments.body: Looks nice but the camera motion is awful.

replies.body: the original snakes nokia n-gage is like that, so i intended mimicking it, and the control is really good using touchscreen.
